title: Fairness-Aware Graph Neural Networks: A Survey

bias_targets.methodology: Surveyed as a sensitive attribute across numerous graph benchmark datasets (e.g., Pokec, Facebook, MovieLens) using predictive fairness metrics like Statistical Parity and Equal Opportunity, as well as representation bias and structural graph metrics.
Evaluated in the surveyed literature by treating age as a sensitive demographic attribute in node classification and link prediction tasks on datasets such as Credit and MovieLens.
Assessed in the surveyed works using social network graphs (e.g., Twitter, Retweet-pol) via homophily metrics and predictive fairness metrics to measure algorithmic bias in Graph Neural Networks.
Measured in surveyed works using defendant similarity graphs (e.g., the Recidivism dataset) to evaluate node classification fairness.
Surveyed via graph datasets (e.g., Pokec, NBA, DBLP) where geographic region, country, or continent is used as the sensitive attribute for fairness evaluation in downstream tasks.
Evaluated by treating a node's topological degree as a sensitive attribute to measure and mitigate predictive disparities between high-degree and low-degree nodes during GNN neighborhood aggregation.
Surveyed as a sensitive attribute evaluated using graph benchmark datasets (e.g., job categories in MovieLens and Hospital-cont datasets) for link prediction and classification fairness.
